title: Switching device (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. A circuit breaker, disconnector or earth switch in a substation, with its normal state. It sits between busbar sections (from, to) or between a section and the circuit it switches (line, transformer, generator or demand). Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: the switch states do not change the authored topology (the check that the states imply a bus split the authored buses do not show is slice 5c).

normalOpen.description: True when the device is open in the normal running arrangement.

breakingCurrentA.description: Rated short-circuit breaking current of a breaker, amperes (RMS).

from.description: The busbar section on one side.

to.description: The busbar section on the other side (absent for a bay device or an earth switch).

line.description: The line the device switches (a line bay).

transformer.description: The transformer the device switches (a transformer bay).

generator.description: The generator the device switches (a generator bay).

demand.description: The demand the device switches (a feeder bay).
